items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: And Eric Schuyper got it, and he was one of the best trumpet players we had.

ctx.x: Who were the best drummer you had you think? Russ was the best drummer.

Yeah. Russ was the best. See, Russ played bass, trumpet, and drum, but his first instrument was drum. He was a good timekeeper. Yeah, he got his son was good too. This boy Raymond is good, you understand me? He's good too. All them boys was good. You see what the whole set up of it is, was that like I told you, we had to have somebody, because we played flow shows. And Oral Palmer, his mom and them used to be on the flow shows. See we used to play flow shows and everything. Oral Palmer used to be one of them one…
